 aim ---> look and count the total similarities between each of the assessments and nlp features
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library("duckdb")
library("dplyr")
library("pacman")
pacman::p_load(stringr, tidyverse, gtsummary, ggplot2, GGally, vtable, grid, gridExtra, diffdf, corrplot, broom, purrr)
source("replace_chunk.R")
peter_file <- "C:/Users/samake/OneDrive - Oregon Health & Science University/AD and DS Project/csand_data.duckdb/csand_data.duckdb"
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(peter_file))

```


### get Spontaneous Speech

```{r}
raw_ss_data<- tbl(con,"visits_nlp_tier1") %>% 
  select(contains(c('Tss')), visit_id) %>% 
  collect

```
### get ss assessments
```{r}
tbl_ss_raw <- tbl(con,"visits_assessments") %>% 
  select(-starts_with("extract")) %>% 
  select( visit_id, starts_with("spon")) %>% #, contains(c("grandftr_status"," grandftr_com", "")) 
  collect

tbl_ss <- tbl_ss_raw %>% 
  filter_out(if_all(-contains(c('visit_id')), is.na))
```

### selecting feature: "participant_ums_or_ahs"----> dont have to do this 

```{r}
um_data <- raw_ss_data %>% 
  #select(contains("participant_ums_or_ahs")) %>% 
  filter_out(if_all(-contains(c('visit_id')), is.na))
```



```{r}
check_l <-um_data %>% select(-c(contains("visit_id") ))
na_table<-data.frame(colSums(is.na(check_l)))
```

### get Picnic Description

```{r}
raw_pi_data<- tbl(con,"visits_nlp_tier1") %>% 
  select(contains(c('Tpi')), visit_id) %>% 
  collect
```
### clean up 

```{r}
pi_data <- raw_pi_data %>% 
  #select(contains("participant_ums_or_ahs")) %>% 
  filter_out(if_all(-contains(c('visit_id')), is.na))
```

### get pi assessments
```{r}
tbl_pi_raw <- tbl(con,"visits_assessments") %>% 
  select(-starts_with("extract")) %>% 
  select( visit_id, starts_with("picn")) %>% #, contains(c("grandftr_status"," grandftr_com", "")) 
  collect

tbl_pi<- tbl_pi_raw %>% 
  filter_out(if_all(-contains(c('visit_id')), is.na))
```


```{r}
check_l <-um_data %>% select(-c(contains("visit_id") ))
na_table<-data.frame(colSums(is.na(check_l)))
```




### get grandfather task
```{r}
raw_gf_data<- tbl(con,"visits_nlp_tier1") %>% 
  select(contains(c('Tgf')), visit_id) %>% 
  collect
```

```{r}
gf_data <- raw_gf_data %>% 
  #select(contains("participant_ums_or_ahs")) %>% 
  filter_out(if_all(-contains(c('visit_id')), is.na))
```

###   differenvt visit_id
```{r}
pi_visit <-  pi_data %>% 
  select(visit_id)

ss_visit <- um_data %>% 
  select(visit_id)

gf_visit <- gf_data %>% 
  select(visit_id)

ss_assess_visit <- tbl_ss %>% 
  select(visit_id)

pi_assess_visit <- tbl_pi %>% 
  select(visit_id)
```

### diff statements 
```{r}
setdiff(pi_visit, ss_visit)
```

```{r}
setdiff(gf_visit, ss_visit)
```

```{r}
setdiff(pi_visit, gf_visit)
```

### diff between assessments
```{r}

```
